package scoping

func shadow(x int) int {
	total := x
	if total := total + 1; total > 2 {
		x = total
	} else if other := total * 2; other > 1 {
		x = other
	}
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		total := i
		x += total
	}
	{
		total := 5
		x += total
	}
	switch v := x; {
	case v > 1:
		x = v
	}
	var total2, other int = 1, 2
	return x + total2 + other + total
}
